spec.name: menu-forest-war-march-full
spec.prompt: A war march through an ancient enchanted forest: proud, determined, a little mysterious. Steady deep war drums and frame drums, a driving low string ostinato, a noble French horn melody answered by a wooden flute, harp glints and a wordless choir rising at the swell. Moderate march tempo, D minor. A two-and-a-half-minute instrumental main menu theme for a fantasy real-time strategy game, made to loop: a quiet opening with harp and low drums, the full march with the horn theme, a softer middle where the wooden flute carries the melody over strings, a final great swell with choir and horns, then it settles back to the quiet drums of the opening so the restart is seamless. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only: no drum kit, no synth leads, no electronic or modern pop sound, no sung words.
